name: 42-invalid-cdx-sidecar-missing-hash
description: CycloneDX document references the distributed AIBOM sidecar by filename and provides hashes, but none of them use SHA-256. Verifier rejects at hash-match stage because every matching sidecar reference must carry a SHA-256 binding.
notes: This fixture exercises the no-SHA-256 branch separately from the stale-value branch covered by fixture 17. The AIBOM sidecar bytes are otherwise valid and canonical; the failure is solely that the matching type:bom external reference carries only a SHA-512 digest, so the verifier never gets the required SHA-256 binding to the canonical sidecar bytes.
